summary: A dry, clear day with a frosty start: around 0–1 °C at Medinaceli and Daroca between 07:00 and 09:50, warming to 11–14 °C by midday. No closures, roadworks, strikes or events found that affect the A-2 or N-234 on 28 Nov.

items.title: Frost on bridges and shaded bends early on
items.detail: Near 0 °C on the morning leg, dry and clear, with possible mist patches near Daroca. Take bridges and the N-234 bends gently until mid-morning; no AEMET warning found for 28 Nov.

items.title: Bus-VAO lane on the A-2 toward Madrid
items.detail: The A-2 now has a Bus-VAO (high-occupancy) lane between Alcalá and Madrid. Check the overhead signs for who may use it before moving into it on the way back to the airport.

weather.sky: clear morning, fair afternoon, cloudy evening
